facts.text: I am working on a project to launch a new product line of reusable water bottles.
I need help analyzing customer data to inform my marketing strategy.
I am planning to take 2 more courses in the next quarter to enhance my data analysis skills.
I plan to use Google Analytics to track website traffic and customer interactions.
I want to set up and track key metrics including conversion rates and bounce rates to measure the success of marketing campaigns.
I am interested in setting up conversion tracking for a reusable water bottle product launch.
I want to set up event tracking code to track when a customer adds the product to their cart or makes a purchase.
I am not sure how to trigger the event tracking code when a customer adds the product to their cart or makes a purchase.
I am not sure whether the event tracking code needs to be added to a specific button or form on my website.
I am not sure how to handle when a customer adds multiple products to their cart for event tracking.
I need to decide whether to send a separate event for each product added to the cart or send a single event listing all products.
I think I need to take a course on Google Analytics to enhance my skills, especially with ecommerce tracking.
